title: Marked Personas: Using Natural Language Prompts to Measure Stereotypes in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate first-person persona descriptions based on specific racial or ethnic groups, and identifying statistically distinguishing words compared to an unmarked default (White) using the Fightin' Words method (weighted log-odds ratios), Jensen-Shannon Divergence, and SVM classification.

Prompting LLMs to generate first-person persona descriptions based on specific genders (man, woman, nonbinary), and extracting statistically distinguishing words compared to an unmarked default (man) using log-odds ratios and other comparative statistical measures.

Prompting LLMs to generate first-person persona descriptions using combined race and gender identities (e.g., Black woman, Asian nonbinary), and identifying statistically distinguishing words compared to combined unmarked defaults (White man) to surface unique intersectional stereotypes and essentializing tropes.
